How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
For orders to the contiguous U.S., processing currently averages 1–2 business days before shipping. After that, estimated transit time is 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 to the Central U.S., 4–5 to the Midwest, and 5–7 to the East Coast. Business days exclude weekends and holidays, and delivery dates aren’t guaranteed.
You can check the latest estimates on our Shipping & Delivery page.
